name: Sardor Isle
summary: At feathermoon stronghold, night elves hold Sardor Isle against beasts and naga along its wild shores. The island guards Feralas's western coast, north of the Isle of Dread.

sections.title: Sentinel Bastion and Wild Shores
sections.body:
Across the water from mainland Feralas, Sardor Isle is held by feathermoon stronghold, an elven garrison commanded by General Shandris Feathermoon. The fortress is heavily fortified, and a regular ferry links it to the mainland.

Beyond its walls, the island remains wild. Wolf packs roam the timbered slopes, while naga lurk along the rocky western and northern beaches, testing the night elven sentinels.

faq.answer: Sardor Isle lies off Feralas's western coast in southern Kalimdor, just north of the Isle of Dread. A ferry runs from the Forgotten Coast on the mainland.

faq.q: What is the main settlement on Sardor Isle?
faq.answer: Feathermoon Stronghold is Sardor Isle's main settlement, a night elven fortress and staging ground for the Alliance in Feralas. General Shandris Feathermoon commands it.

faq.q: What threats are found on the island outside the stronghold?
faq.answer: Beyond Feathermoon Stronghold's walls, wild wolves prowl the woods and hostile naga lurk around coastal reefs and beaches.

faq.q: How does Sardor Isle differ from the Isle of Dread?
aliases: sardor isle vs isle of dread
faq.answer: Sardor Isle lies north of the Isle of Dread, held by the night elves of Feathermoon Stronghold. Farther south, the Isle of Dread is harsher and untamed, with dangerous chimaeras and naga.

angles.text: For the Alliance, Sardor Isle is its main foothold in Feralas. Feathermoon Stronghold offers safe harbor, supplies, and flight masters.
As a night elf, you know the Sentinels under General Shandris Feathermoon watch the ancient ruins and rising naga threats throughout Feralas.
